extracted.name: Vegan Mayo
extracted.description: This thick, creamy vegan mayo is just as good as the real thing! Stored in an airtight container in the fridge, it will keep for about 2 weeks.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup liquid from 1 can of chickpeas
instruction_lines: In a blender, place the chickpea liquid, lemon juice, mustard, sugar, and salt and pulse to combine.
With the blade running, slowly drizzle in the sunflower oil and blend until thickened.
